about: Pass 6 research (2026-10-09), topic CharXiv (charxiv-rq reasoning, charxiv-dq descriptive; VALIDATION set, no tools). Goal: more models measured on the CharXiv reasoning test so Command A+'s vendor-reported 52.7% can be read against them. Candidate rows only; data/ was not edited. Merge: ledger entries first (strip action/why; add_match entries extend existing entries), then results via npm run import. No new benchmarks or models. Validated with a Python port of lib/sources.ts sourceIn(): every result resolves to its source_id with the proposed ledger applied, every model/bench id exists, and no row duplicates an existing model+bench+source. held_for_owner rows are NOT part of results/ledger. 'skipped' lists with-tools, duplicate and other-lab cells that were deliberately left out.
